methodologyNotes: Covers benchtop temperature-controlled soldering stations and standalone smart/portable soldering irons with closed-loop tip-temperature control, sold at a published US price. Excludes hot-air rework stations, dedicated desoldering guns/stations, and uncontrolled fixed-wattage soldering irons or pencils. Price is typical US MSRP or street price in USD. powerWatts is the rated heating power delivered to the iron/handpiece in watts (peak power where the maker publishes only peak). tempRangeCelsius is the adjustable setpoint range in degrees C, expressed 'min to max'. tempStabilityCelsius is idle temperature stability as +/- degrees C; null if not disclosed. heatUpTimeSec is the manufacturer-stated time in seconds to reach soldering temperature (~350 C) from cold. displayType is an enum: digital-lcd, color-lcd, oled, analog-dial, or none. tipSeries is the tip-cartridge family the station natively accepts (e.g., T18, T15, TD-200, T210, T245, STTC). channels is the number of independent iron ports (integer). powerSource is an enum: ac-mains, usb-c-pd, or dc-barrel. esdSafe is a boolean, true when the maker rates the unit ESD-safe. sleepMode is a boolean, true when auto sleep/setback/hibernation is built in. weightGrams is the control-unit weight in grams (iron weight for cordless USB-C irons).
